commit.message:
8394679: ZGC: `ZRelocateWork::update_remset_promoted` iterates invisible arrays

update_remset_promoted() used basic_oop_iterate(), which does not skip
invisible object arrays (large arrays still being cleared). Use the _safe
variant, like the other relocation and promotion paths.

No regression test: the array must be allocated before young mark start
and still be mid-clearing when its medium page is promoted. Clearing
finishes well before that, and a stress test never hit the assert.
